frontmatter.title: Understanding LCOM (Lack of Cohesion in Methods) Metric Version 1: Measuring Code Cohesion for Better Software
frontmatter.subheading: A Deep Dive into LCOM1 and Its Impact on Class Design and Maintainability
frontmatter.excerpt: Explore the LCOM (Lack of Cohesion in Methods) metric version 1, why it matters in object-oriented programming, how it is calculated, and how to use it to improve your code's cohesion. Includes code examples in JavaScript and practical advice for developers.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
